description: A reference to a single input column of an immediate source of a defining-SQL object. Identity is by ColumnModel id (not name) so the reference survives rename, 'select *', JOIN name collisions, and expression wrapping. Modeled with primitive fields to keep the schema schema-to-pojo friendly.

sourceObjectId.description: The id of the immediate source object (table/view) this input column comes from, e.g. 'syn123'.

sourceVersionNumber.description: The version of the source object, present only when the defining SQL pinned the source at a specific version. When null the reference is to the current version of the source.

sourceColumnId.description: The ColumnModel id of the input column on the source object.
